observations: Photo 0 shows a black mirrorless camera with a lens attached, placed on a blue textured surface. The camera body has 'LUMIX' and 'G' visible on the top right. The lens has '14-140' printed on it.

Photo 1 shows the same camera from a top-down angle with the screen open, displaying 'Please set the clock'. The camera body has 'LUMIX' printed on the top. A battery and a charger are placed next to the camera.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some visible wear and dust on the lens and body. The screen is powered on in photo 1, suggesting it is functional.
No model number is visible on the camera body or lens in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Lumix G7' camera, but no such label is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used Lumix G7 mirrorless camera.
claims.evidence: The brand 'Panasonic' and 'Lumix' are visible in both photos, but the model 'G7' is not readable on the camera body or lens. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the photos.
Photo 1 shows two batteries and a charger next to the camera.

risks.risk: The camera may not be a Lumix G7, but a different model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body showing the model name, or a photo of the lens barrel showing the model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Lumix mirrorless camera, not as a G7, which would reduce value.

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The batteries or charger may be non-functional or damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the battery terminals and charger contacts, and a video showing the charger charging the battery.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as batteries and charger not included or not working, which reduces value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the camera body showing the model name.
A video showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
A close-up photo of the battery terminals and charger contacts.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
